_about: The demo video's single source of timing. Every scene renders to exactly its window; recordings drop into their slots. Seconds from the start of the video. Total 2:53, hard cap 3:00.

scenes.what: Yoshua at the desk reads the bill on his laptop, reacts, picks up his phone to text PacePay. (Take: IMG_4903, 8.8s.)

captions.text: No way. Is this due today?
I only get paid next Thursday.
There's no way I can make this.

scenes.transition_in: push into the raised phone, then cut to the generated screen
scenes.what: Photo sent, PacePay reply, chart, three options with the -$300 line highlighted, he replies 1, OKs the $25 fee limit, Calling your lender now.

overlays: imessage approve segment, inset, when the approval text arrives
scenes.what: Call thread UI over the real call audio, jump-cut at each lender turn. Offer checker rows: Wed no fee (no), Fri $35 (no, over the fee limit), Fri $20 (works).
scenes.audio: recordings/call.m4a, cut to 40s by the cue list made after the take

scenes.transition_out: the Done text pushes into the dashboard; the red dip sweeps green
scenes.what: Done. Car payment is now Fri, Nov 13 ($20). Then the dashboard forecast going green.
Dashboard Home, slow camera move. Track tags fade in one by one: PNC, NVIDIA, Photon.

voice.line: That's PacePay. Most overdrafts come down to timing. PacePay sees every account, catches the shortfall early, and fixes it by text or phone. We built it for the PNC, NVIDIA and Photon tracks.

scenes.what: The eight accounts rise in under the scores as they are named (accounts.html), then clear; the four scores light up in turn.

voice.line: Eight accounts, and four health scores: emergency fund, card use, debt versus income, and net worth.

scenes.what: Try a purchase: 900 types in, the forecast line redraws below zero, checking goes red.

voice.line: Thinking about buying something? Type it in. Nine hundred dollars would overdraw checking.

scenes.what: Ram's line over the what-if (held), then the inbound call screen crossfades in: Yoshua's real call to PacePay. Greeting, PIN typed on the keypad (muted, shown as ****), verified, the two money questions, then he decides: "Okay, card it is. Thank you." PacePay: "Okay, talk soon. Bye!". The numbers PacePay says pop in top right. No music.
scenes.call_audio: recordings/inbound.m4a, cut by inbound-cuts.json (PIN exchange removed), placed at start + call_at

scenes.what: Back to the live dashboard (captured after the deal): Try a purchase $900 on Checking (overdraws, red), the Card toggle is pressed, the chart redraws green and the panel updates to $100 -> $100, card use 56% -> 74%. No voice; music at transition level.
Activity tab. Camera settles on one step and holds about 3s on its Nemotron model label.

voice.line: Every step PacePay takes shows up here, labeled with the NVIDIA Nemotron model that did it.

scenes.what: Arena grid of 50 runs fills in; the stats count up: 0 limit violations, 0 disclosures.

voice.line: We tested it against fifty simulated lenders. It never broke a limit or leaked a balance.

scenes.what: Clean logo card: the mark, pacepay wordmark, tagline, pacepay.work.

audio_mix._music_note: music.wav is normalized to -18 LUFS by make-music.mjs; 0.3 puts it near -28.5 LUFS under the -16 LUFS voices, louder in the boost windows, ducked under speech
